response.sql: SELECT AVG(order_avg_remain) AS avg_of_order_avgs, SUM(order_exec_count) AS total_order_executions FROM (SELECT ordersmark, AVG(remaincount) AS order_avg_remain, COUNT(*) AS order_exec_count FROM orderexecutions WHERE expirespot BETWEEN '2025-02-28 08:29:46.10496' AND '2025-03-13 08:29:46.068533' GROUP BY ordersmark) AS per_order;
